ldo_05.scs — 0.5V VCO-core LDO (Plan C, paper Sec.IV Fig.12 LDO)
Paper: STG1 folded-cascode error amp (100uA, UGB 100MHz) + STG2 master-slave
with RC LPF (fc~1MHz) on the master branch, unity feedback, VBGR
pre-filtered, PSR >55dB up to 10MHz. Supplies VDDOSC=0.5V from 1V.
v1 simplifications (documented; iterate after PSR measurement):
- error amp = 5T OTA on 0.8V rail (paper: folded-cascode on 1V)
- single pass device + RC LPF between EA output and pass gate
(master-slave branch not yet implemented)
- reference VBG supplied externally (bandgap later)
pins: VDD (0.8 analog rail, EA supply)  VIN (1.0)  VBG (0.5 ref)
VBL (EA tail bias, 0.7)           VOUT (0.5 regulated)  VSS
